176:   if not state.active_session or not state.messages then
177:     return
178:   end
179: 
180:   local msg = message --[[@as OpencodeMessage]]
181:   if not msg or not msg.info or not msg.info.id or not msg.info.sessionID then
182:     return
183:   end

185:   if state.active_session.id ~= msg.info.sessionID then
186:     return
187:   end

189:   local rendered_message = ctx.render_state:get_message(msg.info.id)
190:   local found_msg = rendered_message and rendered_message.message or find_message_in_state(msg.info.id)
191: 
192:   if revert_index then
193:     if not found_msg then
194:       table.insert(state.messages, msg)
195:       found_msg = msg
196:     end
197:     ctx.render_state:set_message(found_msg, 0, 0)
198:     replay_orphan_parts(msg.info.id, revert_index)
199:     return
200:   end
201: 
202:   if found_msg then
203:     if not rendered_message then
204:       ctx.render_state:set_message(found_msg)
205:       flush.mark_message_dirty(msg.info.id)
206:     end
207:     local error_changed = not vim.deep_equal(found_msg.info.error, msg.info.error)
208:     found_msg.info = msg.info
209: 
210:     -- Errors arrive on the message but we display them after the last part.
211:     -- Re-render the last part (or the header if there are no parts) so the
212:     -- error appears in the right place.
213:     if error_changed then
214:       local last_part_id = get_last_part_for_message(found_msg)
215:       if last_part_id then
216:         flush.mark_part_dirty(last_part_id, msg.info.id)
217:       else

219:       end
220:     end

223:     ctx.render_state:set_message(msg)
224:     replay_orphan_parts(msg.info.id)
225:     flush.mark_message_dirty(msg.info.id)
226:     state.renderer.set_current_message(msg)

281: ---@param properties {part: OpencodeMessagePart}
282: ---@param revert_index? integer
283: function M.on_part_updated(properties, revert_index)
284:   if not properties or not properties.part or not state.active_session then
285:     return
286:   end
287: 
288:   local part = properties.part
289:   if not part.id or not part.messageID or not part.sessionID then
290:     return
291:   end
292: 
293:   -- Child-session parts: update the task-tool display instead
294:   if state.active_session.id ~= part.sessionID then
295:     if part.tool or part.type == 'tool' then
296:       ctx.render_state:upsert_child_session_part(part.sessionID, part)
297:       local task_part_id = ctx.render_state:get_task_part_by_child_session(part.sessionID)
298:       if task_part_id then
299:         flush.mark_part_dirty(task_part_id)
300:       end
301:     end
302:     return
303:   end
304: 
305:   local rendered_message = ctx.render_state:get_message(part.messageID)
306:   if not rendered_message then
307:     local existing_message = find_message_in_state(part.messageID)
308:     if existing_message then
309:       ctx.render_state:set_message(existing_message)
310:       rendered_message = ctx.render_state:get_message(part.messageID)
311:     end
312:   end
313:   if not rendered_message or not rendered_message.message then
314:     ctx.render_state:upsert_orphan_part(part.messageID, part)
315:     return
316:   end
317: 
318:   local message = rendered_message.message
319:   message.parts = message.parts or {}
320: 
321:   local part_data = ctx.render_state:get_part(part.id)
322:   local is_new_part = not part_data
323: 
324:   local prev_last_part_id = get_last_part_for_message(message)
325:   local existing_part_index = nil
326:   for i = #message.parts, 1, -1 do
327:     if message.parts[i].id == part.id then
328:       existing_part_index = i
329:       break
330:     end
331:   end
332: 
333:   -- Update the part reference in the message
334:   if is_new_part then
335:     if existing_part_index then
336:       message.parts[existing_part_index] = part
337:     else
338:       table.insert(message.parts, part)
339:     end
340:   else
341:     if existing_part_index then
342:       message.parts[existing_part_index] = part
343:     else
344:       for i = #message.parts, 1, -1 do
345:         if message.parts[i].id == part.id then
346:           message.parts[i] = part
347:           break
348:         end
349:       end
350:     end
351:   end
352: 
353:   -- step-start / step-finish are bookkeeping only — nothing to render
354:   if part.type == 'step-start' or part.type == 'step-finish' then
355:     return
356:   end
357: 
358:   if is_new_part then
359:     ctx.render_state:set_part(part)
360:   else
361:     local rendered_part = ctx.render_state:update_part_data(part)
362:     -- Part known but never rendered yet — treat as new
363:     if not rendered_part or (not rendered_part.line_start and not rendered_part.line_end) then
364:       is_new_part = true
365:     end
366:   end
367: 
368:   -- Update the permission window if this part has a pending permission
369:   if part.callID and state.pending_permissions then
370:     for _, permission in ipairs(state.pending_permissions) do
371:       local tool = permission.tool
372:       local perm_callID = tool and tool.callID or permission.callID
373:       local perm_messageID = tool and tool.messageID or permission.messageID
374:       if perm_callID == part.callID and perm_messageID == part.messageID then
375:         permission_window.update_permission_from_part(permission.id, part)
376:         break
377:       end
378:     end
379:   end
380: 
381:   if revert_index and is_new_part then
382:     return
383:   end
384: 
385:   if is_new_part then
386:     flush.mark_part_dirty(part.id, part.messageID)
387: 
388:     -- If there's already an error on this message, adjust adjacent parts so
389:     -- the error only appears after the last part.
390:     if message.info.error then
391:       if not prev_last_part_id then
392:         flush.mark_message_dirty(part.messageID)
393:       elseif prev_last_part_id ~= part.id then
394:         flush.mark_part_dirty(prev_last_part_id, part.messageID)
395:       end
396:     end
397:   else
398:     flush.mark_part_dirty(part.id, part.messageID)
399:   end
400: 
401:   -- File / agent mentions: re-render the text part to highlight them
402:   if (part.type == 'file' or part.type == 'agent') and part.source then
403:     local text_part_id = find_text_part_for_message(message)
404:     if text_part_id then
405:       flush.mark_part_dirty(text_part_id, part.messageID)
